arxiv-2102-09945.title: Monogenity in totally complex sextic fields, revisited
arxiv-2102-09945.creator: István Gaál
arxiv-2102-09945.description: Abstract In addition to rather complicated general methods it is interesting and valuable to develop fast efficient methods for calculating generators of power integral bases in special types of number fields. We consider sextic fields containing a real cubic and a complex quadratic fields.

arxiv-2111-11298.title: Novel EEG based Schizophrenia Detection with IoMT Framework for Smart Healthcare
arxiv-2111-11298.creator: Geetanjali Sharma 1 2 , Amit M. Joshi 1 ,
arxiv-2111-11298.description: Abstract In the field of neuroscience, Brain activity analysis is always considered as an important area. Schizophrenia(Sz) is a brain disorder that severely affects the thinking, behavior, and feelings of people all around the world. Electroencephalography (EEG) is proved to be an efficient biomarker in Sz detection.

arxiv-2207-08575.title: Anisotropic spacetimes in f ⁡ ( T , B ) f(T,B) theory IV: Noether symmetry analysis
arxiv-2207-08575.creator: Andronikos Paliathanasis
arxiv-2207-08575.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Andronikos Paliathanasis. The Noether symmetry analysis is applied for the analysis of the field equations in an anisotropic background in f ⁡ ( T , B ) f(T,B) -theory. We consider the f ⁡ ( T , B ) = T + F ⁡ ( B ) f\left(T,B\right)=T+F\left(B\right) which describes a small deviation from TEGR introduced by the boundary scalar B B . For the Bianchi I, Bianchi III and Kantowski-Sachs geometries there exists a minisuperspace description and Noether’s theorems are applied.

arxiv-2208-10713.title: Domain Decomposition of Stochastic PDEs: Development of Probabilistic Wirebasket-based Two-level Preconditioners
arxiv-2208-10713.creator: Ajit Desai, Mohammad Khalil, Chris L. Pettit, Dominique Poirel, Abhijit Sarkar
arxiv-2208-10713.description: Abstract Realistic physical phenomena exhibit random fluctuations across many scales in the input and output processes. Models of these phenomena require stochastic PDEs. For three-dimensional coupled (vector-valued) stochastic PDEs (SPDEs), for instance, arising in linear elasticity, the existing two-level domain decomposition solvers with the vertex-based coarse grid show poor numerical and parallel scalabilities.

arxiv-2210-05730.creator: Ernesto Carro, Luis Benet, Isaac Pérez Castillo
arxiv-2210-05730.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ernesto Carro, Luis Benet, Isaac Pérez Castillo. In spite of its simplicity, the central limit theorem captures one of the most outstanding phenomena in mathematical physics, that of universality. It states that, while navigating the set of all possible distributions by their convolution there exists a fixed point, the family of Gaussian distributions, with a fairly large basin of attraction comprising a wide family of weakly correlated distributions.

arxiv-2301-04213.title: Does Localization Inform Editing? Surprising Differences in Causality-Based Localization vs. Knowledge Editing in Language Models
arxiv-2301-04213.creator: Peter Hase Mohit Bansal Been Kim Asma Ghandeharioun
arxiv-2301-04213.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Peter Hase Mohit Bansal Been Kim Asma Ghandeharioun. Language models learn a great quantity of factual information during pretraining, and recent work localizes this information to specific model weights like mid-layer MLP weights [ 21 ] . In this paper, we find that we can change how a fact is stored in a model by editing weights that are in a different location than where existing methods suggest that the fact is stored.

arxiv-2306-11487.title: Efficient Large-scale Nonstationary Spatial Covariance Function Estimation Using Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2306-11487.creator: Pratik Nag, Yiping Hong, Sameh Abdulah, Ghulam A. Qadir
arxiv-2306-11487.description: Abstract Spatial processes observed in various fields, such as climate and environmental science, often occur on a large scale and demonstrate spatial nonstationarity. Fitting a Gaussian process with a nonstationary Matérn covariance is challenging. Previous studies in the literature have tackled this challenge by employing spatial partitioning techniques to estimate the parameters that vary spatially in the covariance function.

arxiv-2410-11737.creator: Dibakar Das, Biplab Satpati c , Md Arif & Gourab Das (Student Member, IEEE)
arxiv-2410-11737.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dibakar Das, Biplab Satpati c , Md Arif & Gourab Das (Student Member, IEEE). The present work is an attempt to understand and review existing methods of energy generation in electric vehicles in the modern day context. Previous works in the field have proposed various mechanisms of energy generation that are very well adaptable to commercial scale uses and can be used as alternative power sourcing for electric vehicles having nil or very low environmental impact.

pmc-12467948.creator: Ning Xia, Sirui Liang, Dehua Deng, Yong Chang, Xinyao Yi
pmc-12467948.description: The preparation of new inorganic–organic hybrid materials is beneficial for the development of powerful sensing methods and technologies. Metal ions are ubiquitous in nature and play an important role in the development of inorganic–organic hybrid materials.

pmc-12672489.title: Soil quality enhancement drives tree growth and broadleaf dominance in fir-broadleaf mixed plantations
pmc-12672489.creator: Zhigao Fu, Yihua Xiao, Shirong Liu, Han Xu, Yan Wang, Huosheng Zhu
pmc-12672489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionEvaluating soil quality is essential for guiding reforestation and land management strategies, particularly in degraded Chinese fir plantations where long-term productivity and successional dynamics remain poorly understood.MethodsThis study assessed ten mixed-species planting patterns to quantify the Soil Quality Index (SQI) using a Minimum Data Set (MDS) approach, which reduces data redundancy by statistically identifying key indicators from a larger dataset, thereby effectively capturing essential soil functions, and subsequently explored the relationships between SQI and stand growth, structural diversity, biomass, net primary productivity
